select doi.id, doi.platform_order_id, doi.source_platform, doi.shop_name, doi.item_total, round(doi.item_total * doi.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, round(doi.item_total * doi.cny_settle_rate,2) as cny_settle_amount, doi.buyer_name, doi.man_phone, doi.second_phone, doi.man_street, doi.second_street, doi.country_name_cn, doi.order_state, doi.correction_status, doi.create_time, doi.platform_order_id, doi.delivery_time, doi.charge_name from dmp_order_info doi
and doi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and doi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and doi.source_platform like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and doi.order_state = #{params.orderState}
and doi.create_time >= #{params.createTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.create_time <= #{params.createTime_end}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time >= #{params.deliveryTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time <= #{params.deliveryTime_end}::timestamp
